profile.headline: Software Engineer at GoodLeap
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Application Architecture · Software Design · Distributed Systems · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Flutter · TypeScript · Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Engineered workflow for data inputs and data visualization
– Developed features for internal company website
– Programmed features for internal mobile app and patient mobile app
– Maintained database settings and permissions, with frequent unit tests to validate performance
– Engineered back end business logic to support API and connected platforms
– Assisted with development of manufacturing processes and software

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
- Wrote Mocha test suite for API verification
- Verified API settings using NodeJS scripts
- Created API functions for mobile app and website features 
- Developed features for internal website and mobile app using Flutter & Dart
- Managed database permissions for all end users
- Created and managed Software Document Control files

positions.title: Data Specialist
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
- Created json scripts to retrieve and format data from third party API’s
- Tested JavaScript programs to account for common user errors and reduce manual input necessary
- Developed Python scripts to format and clean data according to software needs
- Performed data analysis with Python scripts for quality assurance tests

positions.title: Microsoft Support Ambassador
positions.description:
- Designed and developed visualization features to improve ambassador user communication in front-end web application
- Provided troubleshooting of Microsoft Office Suite for global users,
achieving 90% resolution on over 3000 cases
- Provided Windows Operating System troubleshooting for consumer use
- Selected to work with and review new back-end applications due to
exceptional technical skills

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed and maintained internal customer databases for billing system
- Contributed to the design of inter-enterprise databases to update
contractors on job completion
- Setup automation of invoices for quicker billing using Office applications
- Maintained company email, website and domain license

positions.title: Portfolio Manager
positions.description:
- Maintained Customer Database Systems through federal software
- Created revenue of over $300,000.00 for the collections department in
under a year
- Facilitated transfer of information across departments by becoming
familiar with the software used in other departments
- Updated financial trackers for assigned accounts
